events.name: Jurassic Quest – Syracuse, NY | New York State Fairgrounds
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure Is Here!  

Jurassic Quest is bigger than ever, bringing together dinosaurs, prehistoric sea creatures, and Ice Age giants in one unforgettable experience.  

🦕 Jurassic Quest – Walk among life-sized, moving dinosaurs including the mighty T. rex, towering Apatosaurus, and massive Spinosaurus. Dig for fossils, meet adorable baby dinos, and ride your favorite prehistoric giants.  

🌊 Ancient Oceans – Dive beneath the surface and come face-to-face with incredible creatures that ruled the seas millions of years ago, including our jaw-dropping 53-foot Megalodon.  

❄️ Frozen Frontier – Step into the Ice Age and encounter legendary creatures like the Woolly Mammoth and Saber-Toothed Cat as you explore a world frozen in time.  

Plus enjoy interactive exhibits, hands-on activities, inflatables, rides, photo opportunities, and prehistoric fun for the whole family.  

🎟️ One ticket gets you access to all three incredible experiences. Don't miss North America's largest prehistoric adventure — get your tickets before they go extinct! 🦖✨

events.name: Ladies of the 80's Night Out
events.info: Break out the leg warmers, tease up your hair, and get ready for the ultimate throwback party! Ladies of the 80's Night Out is coming to Middle Ages Music Hall for a night packed with the biggest hits of the decade. Featuring powerful live vocals, a full band, and nonstop energy, this high-octane tribute show celebrates the music that defined the 1980s. Sing and dance along to classics from Madonna, Cyndi Lauper, Pat Benatar, Heart, Blondie, Bon Jovi, Whitesnake, Journey, and more. From pop anthems and rock classics to new wave favorites, every song is a trip back to the era of big hair, neon lights, and unforgettable music. Whether you lived through the 80s or just wish you had, Ladies of the 80's Night Out delivers a nostalgic, costume-filled party that will have you singing every word and dancing all night long. Grab your friends, dress in your best 80s attire, and join us at Middle Ages Music Hall for a night of pure retro fun!

events.name: Monster Jam
events.info: Nothing compares to the one and only Monster Jam®. With awesome trucks, amazing stunts, big air and action-packed excitement, it's the definition of fun for everyone! Watch as 12,000lb trucks stand on two wheels and fly through the air. See the world's most popular trucks like Grave Digger®, El Toro Loco®, Sparkle Smash™ and more only at Monster Jam. You can't get this kind of wow just anywhere. Once you experience Monster Jam live, you'll become a fan for life!
